beaches.title: Beaches
beaches.north_rec: Today the wind blows from the NORTH ({{wind}}). Head for the South Coast (Mazara, Selinunte, Tre Fontane) or sheltered coves: flat, calm sea!
beaches.north_avoid: Avoid the exposed North Coast (Trappeto, Balestrate, Cefalù): rough sea, waves and possibly seaweed on the shore.
beaches.south_rec: Today the wind comes from the SOUTH ({{wind}}). A perfect day close to home! The North Coast (Trappeto, Balestrate, Terrasini) will have calm, crystal-clear water.
beaches.south_avoid: Watch out on the South Coast (Mazara, Campobello): the sea rolls in from offshore and brings waves.
beaches.side_rec: Crosswind from {{wind}}. Choose beaches sheltered by headlands to enjoy the day.
beaches.lock_text: Enter your booking code to see, every day, which beaches to choose and which to avoid.

fest.title: Festivals & fairs
fest.intro: {{n}} events: the patron saints of every town in the provinces of Palermo and Trapani, food fairs, traditional rites and national holidays. List for the next 12 months; dates marked "indicativo" (approximate) should be checked on the official sites before you go.

ex.km: {{km}} km from Trappeto as the crow flies
ex.hours_fallback: They change with the season: check the official site before you go
ex.rec_today: ✓ Recommended today: sheltered from this wind
ex.avoid_today: ⚠️ Not today: it is exposed to this wind
ex.cathedral_desc: The symbol of Palermo. Begun in 1185, it mixes Norman, Gothic, Catalan and Neoclassical styles. Inside are the royal tombs of Roger II and Frederick II; from the roofs you can see the whole city.
ex.cathedral_tip: Go up to the roofs towards sunset: the light over the city is beautiful. Shoulders and legs must be covered in church.
ex.segesta_desc: A 5th-century BC Doric temple in the middle of the countryside, almost intact. One of the best-preserved Greek temples in the world.
ex.segesta_tip: About 30 minutes from Trappeto: go early in the morning or late in the afternoon.
ex.beach_extra: It is the most photographed cove in the Egadi Islands.
ex.beach_howto: Hydrofoil Trapani–Favignana, then bike or scooter (about 4 km from the port)
ex.beach_tip: No facilities and no shade: bring water, a hat and water shoes. Arrive early: by mid-morning it is already full.
